name: Exp_STLMCandle
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom STLMCandle indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator signals bullish momentum and sell positions on bearish momentum. It uses a Jurik-style smoothed indicator (JLength/JPhase parameters) to determine trend direction from candle color states. Entry and exit are controlled by separate boolean flags, allowing selective enablement of long/short opening and closing.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义STLMCandle指标信号进行交易，当指标显示看涨动能时开多仓，看跌动能时开空仓。它使用Jurik平滑指标参数来确定趋势方向，入场和出场由独立的布尔开关控制。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于STLMCandle自定义指标的颜色状态判断趋势方向，指标缓冲区4返回颜色值，当颜色值为2时表示上升趋势，为0时表示下降趋势。入场条件：当Clr[1]==2且Clr[0]<2时触发买入开仓信号，当Clr[1]==0且Clr[0]>0时触发卖出开仓信号，这种颜色状态变化检测实质上是趋势转折的确认。出场条件：当出现相反趋势信号时自动平仓，买入信号触发卖仓平仓，卖出信号触发买仓平仓。仓位管理通过MMMode参数支持多种模式，包括固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于可用保证金百分比等方式。资金管理采用固定止损止盈模式，默认止损1000点、止盈2000点，风险回报比为1:2。策略仅在新K线形成时计算信号，避免逐tick重复计算，提高了效率。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the STLMCandle custom indicator's color state to determine trend direction, where indicator buffer 4 returns color values: 2 for uptrend and 0 for downtrend. Entry conditions: when Clr[1]==2 and Clr[0]<2, a buy signal is triggered; when Clr[1]==0 and Clr[0]>0, a sell signal is triggered, which detects color state transitions as trend reversal confirmations. Exit conditions: opposite trend signals automatically close existing positions, with buy signals closing sell positions and sell signals closing buy positions. Position sizing supports multiple modes through the MMMode parameter, including fixed lot size, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin, and percentage of loss-adjusted margin. Money management uses fixed stop loss and take profit with defaults of 1000 and 2000 points respectively, yielding a risk-reward ratio of 1:2. The strategy only recalculates signals on new bar formation using the CIsNewBar class, avoiding redundant per-tick computation and improving efficiency.

parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（固定手数/余额比例/可用保证金比例等）
parameters.description_en: Margin mode: free margin/balance/drawdown free margin/drawdown balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow buy position close on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow sell position close on reverse signal

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于趋势转折信号入场，符合趋势跟踪交易理念
支持多种仓位管理模式，灵活性高，适应不同风险偏好
入场和出场信号独立控制，可单独禁用买入或卖出方向
使用新K线检测机制避免重复信号，减少无效交易
止损止盈比率为1:2，具有正期望值的风险回报设计
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on trend reversal signals, aligning with trend following principles
Multiple position sizing modes offering flexibility for different risk preferences
Independent entry and exit signal controls allow selective enablement of buy/sell directions
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate signals and reduces invalid trades
Stop loss to take profit ratio of 1:2 provides a positive expectancy risk-reward design
cons: 依赖自定义指标STLMCandle，该指标内部逻辑不透明，难以验证信号可靠性
没有点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下可能导致不必要的亏损
没有最大持仓数量限制，可能在震荡行情中频繁开平仓产生过度交易
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动性（ATR），在不同行情下适应性差
缺少回撤控制和最大亏损限制，极端行情下风险不可控
cons_en: Depends on the custom STLMCandle indicator whose internal logic is opaque, making signal reliability hard to verify
No spread filter mechanism, which may cause unnecessary losses in high-spread environments
No maximum position count limit, potentially leading to over-trading in choppy markets
Fixed stop loss and take profit do not account for market volatility (ATR), reducing adaptability across different conditions
Lacks drawdown control and maximum loss limits, leaving risk uncontrolled in extreme market scenarios
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动性自动调整止损止盈距离
添加点差过滤和最大持仓数量限制，减少不利条件下的交易频率
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to automatically adjust distances based on market volatility
Implement spread filtering and maximum position count limits to reduce trading frequency under adverse conditions

risk_points: 缺少最大回撤限制，连续亏损时无自动保护机制
自定义指标黑盒特性，信号失效时难以诊断和调整
无点差过滤，在高滑点环境下止损可能被严重穿透
risk_points_en: No maximum drawdown limit, lacking automatic protection during consecutive losses
Custom indicator black-box nature makes it difficult to diagnose and adjust when signals fail
No spread filter, stop losses may be severely penetrated in high-slippage environments
